notes: v570 — FULL AUDIT, PART 1. Your combos and formulas were put on trial: the server's entire grading engine was run against an independent re-implementation on synthetic markets with planted, known answers. VERDICT: the maths is CLEAN — fire counts, edges, day-clustered strength, medians and tiers all agree to nine decimal places across all 45 lines; a market with no edge earns (correctly) almost nothing; a planted edge is found exactly where planted and nowhere else; and the app's own numbers mirror the server's bit-for-bit. THE REAL FAULT FOUND: 13 network calls — including the market-data download itself — had NO time limit, which is exactly where your seven-minute hangs lived. Every network call in the app now has a hard timeout sized to its job, so a dead request fails fast and retries instead of hanging forever. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
